scope: CI pipeline, Docker, Kubernetes, monitoring, deployment strategy, GitOps, multi-cluster, service mesh, distributed tracing, backup, secrets scanning

gaps.title: No deployment jobs (staging/production)
gaps.description: CI has no deploy jobs. After docker-build, the pipeline ends. No staging or production deployment, no automated rollout, no GitOps sync.
gaps.impact: All deployments are manual; no gradual traffic shifting or automated rollback
gaps.recommended_fix: Add deploy-staging and deploy-production jobs using ArgoCD/Flux GitOps sync or Helm upgrade

gaps.title: No GPU runner in CI
gaps.description: CI runs only on ubuntu-latest CPU runners. GPU solver modules (gpu_tsp, gpu_vrp) are never exercised in CI.
gaps.impact: GPU code paths are untested; regressions go undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a self-hosted GPU runner job that runs GPU-specific tests

gaps.title: No secrets scanning in CI
gaps.description: No gitleaks or trufflehog scanning. CI runs bandit (SAST) and Trivy (image) but no secrets detection.
gaps.impact: Accidental secret commits (API keys, DB passwords) are not caught before merge
gaps.recommended_fix: Add gitleaks-action to the security job

gaps.title: No integration/e2e test stage
gaps.description: CI only runs unit tests (pytest tests/). Integration and e2e tests are not executed in the pipeline.
gaps.impact: Integration regressions are not caught before merge
gaps.recommended_fix: Add an integration test job (pytest -m integration) after unit tests pass

gaps.title: No dependency vulnerability scanning
gaps.description: CI has no pip-audit or safety check for Python dependencies. Bandit covers SAST only.
gaps.impact: Vulnerable dependencies can be merged undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add pip-audit to the security job

gaps.title: No database migration step
gaps.description: No migration step in CI or deployment pipeline. Schema changes must be applied manually.
gaps.impact: Schema drift between environments; deployment failures due to missing migrations
gaps.recommended_fix: Add an alembic upgrade head step before deployment

gaps.title: No performance benchmarking
gaps.description: No pytest-benchmark or custom timing tests in CI. Performance regressions are invisible.
gaps.impact: Latency regressions accumulate silently
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a benchmark job using pytest-benchmark

gaps.title: No OS matrix
gaps.description: CI only runs on ubuntu-latest. No Windows or macOS testing.
gaps.impact: Platform-specific issues may go undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest] to test matrix

gaps.title: No smoke tests after deployment
gaps.description: No post-deployment smoke tests to verify deployment success.
gaps.impact: Broken deployments are not automatically detected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a smoke test step that curls /health after deploy

gaps.title: Python 3.13 excluded from test matrix
gaps.description: Python 3.13 is in classifiers but not in CI test matrix (excluded due to onnx build failure).
gaps.impact: Forward-compatibility with Python 3.13 is untested
gaps.recommended_fix: Add 3.13 to matrix with allow-failures: true

gaps.title: No branch protection rules visible
gaps.description: No evidence of branch protection rules requiring CI pass before merge.
gaps.impact: Broken code can be merged to main
gaps.recommended_fix: Configure branch protection rules in GitHub settings

gaps.title: No image signing (cosign)
gaps.description: Docker images are not signed. No supply chain integrity verification.
gaps.impact: Images cannot be verified for integrity; supply chain attacks possible
gaps.recommended_fix: Add cosign sign in CI after image build; verify in deployment admission controller

gaps.title: No SBOM generation
gaps.description: No Software Bill of Materials is generated for the image.
gaps.impact: No visibility into image contents for compliance (e.g., CVE audits, license tracking)
gaps.recommended_fix: Add syft or trivy --format spdx to generate SBOM as CI artifact

gaps.title: No distroless base image option
gaps.description: Uses python:3.11-slim which includes a full OS. Distroless would reduce attack surface.
gaps.impact: Larger attack surface than necessary (shell, package manager in image)
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a distroless variant (gcr.io/distroless/python3.11) for production

gaps.title: No version tagging strategy
gaps.description: Image is only tagged as :latest. No semantic versioning or git sha tags.
gaps.impact: Cannot roll back to specific versions; no traceability between code and image
gaps.recommended_fix: Tag images with git sha and semver (e.g., agtech-unified:1.0.0, agtech-unified:sha-abc123)

gaps.title: No docker-compose.prod.yml
gaps.description: Only one docker-compose.yml for all environments. No production override.
gaps.impact: Cannot have environment-specific compose configuration
gaps.recommended_fix: Add docker-compose.prod.yml with production settings

gaps.title: No resource limits in compose
gaps.description: No mem_limit or cpus limits on services in docker-compose.yml.
gaps.impact: Services can consume all host resources
gaps.recommended_fix: Add deploy.resources.limits to each service

gaps.title: No network isolation in compose
gaps.description: All services use a single bridge network. No segmentation between app, db, and messaging.
gaps.impact: No isolation between services
gaps.recommended_fix: Define separate networks for app, db, and messaging

gaps.title: No logging configuration in compose
gaps.description: No logging driver or log rotation configured.
gaps.impact: Log files can grow unbounded
gaps.recommended_fix: Add logging: driver: json-file with max-size and max-file

gaps.title: No rolling update strategy on raw manifest
gaps.description: k8s/deployment.yaml has no strategy.rollingUpdate. Helm template has it but the raw manifest does not.
gaps.impact: Default rolling update may cause downtime or resource spikes if raw manifests are applied
gaps.recommended_fix: Add strategy: rollingUpdate: maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0 to k8s/deployment.yaml

gaps.title: No securityContext on main deployment
gaps.description: k8s/deployment.yaml lacks securityContext (runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false). GPU deployment has it but main does not.
gaps.impact: Container runs with excessive privileges if raw manifests are applied
gaps.recommended_fix: Add securityContext with runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

gaps.title: No ServiceAccount
gaps.description: No ServiceAccount defined in k8s/. Pods use the default service account with full API access.
gaps.impact: Excessive API permissions; any pod compromise has cluster-admin-level access
gaps.recommended_fix: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount with minimal RBAC

gaps.title: No topologySpreadConstraints on raw manifest
gaps.description: k8s/deployment.yaml has no topologySpreadConstraints. Helm template has it but raw manifest does not.
gaps.impact: Pods may all schedule on the same node/AZ if raw manifests are applied
gaps.recommended_fix: Add topologySpreadConstraints with maxSkew: 1, topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone

gaps.title: No affinity/anti-affinity rules
gaps.description: No pod affinity or anti-affinity rules defined in k8s/.
gaps.impact: No control over pod placement; all replicas may land on one node
gaps.recommended_fix: Add podAntiAffinity to spread pods across nodes

gaps.title: No init containers for migrations
gaps.description: No init container to run database migrations before app starts.
gaps.impact: App may start before schema is ready
gaps.recommended_fix: Add initContainer that runs alembic upgrade head

gaps.title: No persistent volumes
gaps.description: No PersistentVolumeClaim for application data storage.
gaps.impact: Data is lost on pod restart
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PVC for application data

gaps.title: No graceful shutdown configuration
gaps.description: No terminationGracePeriodSeconds or preStop hook.
gaps.impact: In-flight requests may be dropped on shutdown
gaps.recommended_fix: Add terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30 and preStop hook

gaps.title: No startup probe
gaps.description: No startup probe defined. Slow-starting containers may be killed by liveness probe.
gaps.impact: Containers that take time to start may be killed prematurely
gaps.recommended_fix: Add startupProbe with failureThreshold: 30, periodSeconds: 10

gaps.title: No HPA behavior configuration on raw manifest
gaps.description: k8s/hpa.yaml has no behavior configuration. Helm template has scaleDown/scaleUp policies but raw manifest does not.
gaps.impact: Potential flapping or slow scale-down if raw manifests are applied
gaps.recommended_fix: Add behavior: scaleDown: stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300

gaps.title: No custom metrics for HPA
gaps.description: HPA only uses CPU and memory. No custom metrics (e.g., request queue depth, GPU utilization).
gaps.impact: Cannot scale on application-specific metrics
gaps.recommended_fix: Add custom metrics via Prometheus Adapter

gaps.title: No VPA (Vertical Pod Autoscaler)
gaps.description: No VPA to recommend or set resource requests.
gaps.impact: Resource requests may be misconfigured over time
gaps.recommended_fix: Add VPA in recommendation mode

gaps.title: No resource quotas
gaps.description: No ResourceQuota defined for the namespace.
gaps.impact: No limit on total resource consumption
gaps.recommended_fix: Add ResourceQuota for the namespace

gaps.title: No limit ranges
gaps.description: No LimitRange defined for the namespace.
gaps.impact: No default resource limits for pods without explicit limits
gaps.recommended_fix: Add LimitRange with default requests/limits

gaps.title: No PodSecurityAdmission
gaps.description: No PodSecurityAdmission configuration.
gaps.impact: No enforcement of security standards
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PodSecurityAdmission with restricted profile

gaps.title: No Kustomize overlays
gaps.description: k8s/ has raw YAML with no Kustomize overlays. Helm chart exists but is not integrated into CI/CD.
gaps.impact: Environment-specific configuration is manual and error-prone
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Kustomize overlays for dev/staging/prod or integrate Helm into CI

gaps.title: No secrets encryption at rest
gaps.description: No etcd encryption or external secrets operator.
gaps.impact: Secrets stored in plaintext in etcd
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable etcd encryption or use External Secrets Operator

gaps.title: No cert-manager Certificate resource
gaps.description: Ingress references a ClusterIssuer but no Certificate resource is defined.
gaps.impact: TLS certificates may not be provisioned automatically
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Certificate resource for agtech-unified-tls

gaps.title: No rate limiting at ingress
gaps.description: No rate limiting annotations on the Ingress.
gaps.impact: API is vulnerable to abuse
gaps.recommended_fix: Add nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps annotation

gaps.title: No WAF configuration
gaps.description: No Web Application Firewall configuration.
gaps.impact: No protection against common web attacks
gaps.recommended_fix: Add ModSecurity or cloud WAF

gaps.title: No audit logging
gaps.description: No Kubernetes audit logging configuration.
gaps.impact: No audit trail of API server actions
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable audit logging with appropriate policy

gaps.title: No liveness/readiness probes on GPU deployment
gaps.description: GPU deployment has no liveness or readiness probes.
gaps.impact: GPU pod health is not monitored
gaps.recommended_fix: Add liveness and readiness probes to gpu-solver container

gaps.title: No PodDisruptionBudget for GPU deployment
gaps.description: GPU deployment has no PDB.
gaps.impact: GPU solver can be disrupted during node maintenance
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PDB with minAvailable: 1 for gpu-solver

gaps.title: No NetworkPolicy for GPU deployment
gaps.description: GPU deployment is not covered by the existing NetworkPolicy (different label selector).
gaps.impact: GPU pod network traffic is unrestricted
gaps.recommended_fix: Extend NetworkPolicy or add GPU-specific policy

gaps.title: No HPA for GPU deployment
gaps.description: GPU solver has no autoscaling configuration.
gaps.impact: GPU workloads cannot scale with demand
gaps.recommended_fix: Add GPU-specific HPA with custom metrics

gaps.title: No Prometheus monitoring stack
gaps.description: No Prometheus, ServiceMonitor, or PodMonitor resources. No metrics collection from the application.
gaps.impact: No visibility into application metrics (request rate, error rate, latency, resource usage)
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy Prometheus Operator (kube-prometheus-stack) and add ServiceMonitor for agtech-unified

gaps.title: No Grafana dashboards
gaps.description: No Grafana instance or dashboard configurations. No visualization of metrics.
gaps.impact: No operational visibility; incidents detected only by user reports
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy Grafana with pre-built dashboards for the application

gaps.title: No alerting rules (PrometheusRule)
gaps.description: No PrometheusRule or alerting configuration. No automated alerting on issues.
gaps.impact: No automated detection of high error rates, latency spikes, or resource exhaustion
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PrometheusRule with alerts for high error rate, high latency, pod crash loops, etc.

gaps.title: No Alertmanager configuration
gaps.description: No Alertmanager for routing alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, or email.
gaps.impact: Alerts have no delivery mechanism
gaps.recommended_fix: Configure Alertmanager with notification channels

gaps.title: No application metrics endpoint
gaps.description: No /metrics endpoint or Prometheus client instrumentation in the application code.
gaps.impact: Prometheus cannot scrape application metrics
gaps.recommended_fix: Add prometheus-client instrumentation and expose /metrics endpoint

gaps.title: No log aggregation (ELK/Loki)
gaps.description: No centralized logging. No Elasticsearch, Loki, or Fluent Bit configuration.
gaps.impact: Logs are lost on pod restart; no cross-service log correlation
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy Loki with Fluent Bit or ELK stack for centralized logging

gaps.title: No SLO/SLA definitions
gaps.description: No Service Level Objectives or SLIs defined for the platform.
gaps.impact: No measurable reliability targets; no error budgets
gaps.recommended_fix: Define SLOs (e.g., 99.9% availability, p99 latency < 500ms) and track with Prometheus

gaps.title: No backup strategy (Velero)
gaps.description: No Velero or similar backup solution. No scheduled backups of persistent volumes or cluster state.
gaps.impact: Data loss on cluster failure, accidental deletion, or corruption
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy Velero with scheduled backups of PVCs and cluster resources to S3/GCS

gaps.title: No disaster recovery plan
gaps.description: No DR plan, no cross-region replication, no RTO/RPO definitions.
gaps.impact: Extended outage on regional failure; no recovery procedure
gaps.recommended_fix: Define DR plan with RTO/RPO targets; deploy Velero with cross-region backup replication

gaps.title: No database backup configuration
gaps.description: No scheduled database backups (TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL). No point-in-time recovery.
gaps.impact: Database data loss on failure; no recovery point
gaps.recommended_fix: Add pg_dump or WAL-G for scheduled database backups

gaps.title: No backup testing/validation
gaps.description: No backup restoration testing. Backups may be corrupt or incomplete.
gaps.impact: Backups may not work when needed
gaps.recommended_fix: Schedule regular backup restoration tests

gaps.title: No gitleaks in CI
gaps.description: No gitleaks or trufflehog scanning for secrets in CI pipeline.
gaps.impact: Accidental secret commits (API keys, DB passwords, JWT secrets) are not caught
gaps.recommended_fix: Add gitleaks-action to CI security job

gaps.title: No external secrets management
gaps.description: Secrets are referenced via Kubernetes Secret objects but no External Secrets Operator or Vault integration.
gaps.impact: Secrets in etcd are base64-encoded (not encrypted); no rotation or audit trail
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy External Secrets Operator with AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, or HashiCorp Vault

gaps.title: No secret rotation policy
gaps.description: No automated secret rotation. JWT secrets and DB credentials are static.
gaps.impact: Compromised secrets remain valid indefinitely
gaps.recommended_fix: Implement secret rotation with External Secrets Operator or custom rotation controller

gaps.title: No GitOps controller (ArgoCD/Flux)
gaps.description: No ArgoCD or Flux configuration. Deployments are manual via kubectl or Helm.
gaps.impact: No declarative GitOps; configuration drift between environments; no automated sync
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy ArgoCD or Flux CD with Git repository as source of truth

gaps.title: No environment promotion pipeline
gaps.description: No automated promotion from dev to staging to production. All environment updates are manual.
gaps.impact: Environment inconsistencies; manual errors in deployment
gaps.recommended_fix: Implement GitOps promotion with ArgoCD ApplicationSets or Flux Kustomization pipelines

gaps.title: No drift detection
gaps.description: No detection of configuration drift between Git and live cluster state.
gaps.impact: Manual changes to cluster are not detected or reverted
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable ArgoCD/Flux drift detection with auto-heal

gaps.title: No rollback mechanism
gaps.description: No automated rollback on deployment failure. Flagger canary exists but no GitOps-level rollback.
gaps.impact: Failed deployments require manual intervention
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable ArgoCD/Flux rollback on sync failure

gaps.title: No multi-cluster management
gaps.description: No multi-cluster configuration. No cluster federation, no cross-cluster service discovery.
gaps.impact: No high availability across regions; single point of failure
gaps.recommended_fix: Evaluate Cluster API or Karmada for multi-cluster management

gaps.title: No cross-cluster backup
gaps.description: No backup replication across clusters or regions.
gaps.impact: Data loss on regional cluster failure
gaps.recommended_fix: Configure Velero with cross-region backup replication

gaps.title: No global load balancing
gaps.description: No global load balancer or multi-cluster ingress (e.g., Istio multi-cluster, GKE Multi-Cluster Ingress).
gaps.impact: No traffic failover across regions
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy global load balancer with health-check-based failover

gaps.title: No service mesh (Istio/Linkerd)
gaps.description: No Istio or Linkerd configuration. Canary references Istio gateways but no Istio control plane is deployed.
gaps.impact: No mTLS between services, no traffic management, no mesh-level observability
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy Istio or Linkerd with mTLS and traffic management

gaps.title: No mTLS between services
gaps.description: No mutual TLS between pods. All inter-service traffic is plaintext.
gaps.impact: No service-to-service authentication; traffic interception possible
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable Istio mTLS in strict mode or Linkerd mTLS

gaps.title: No traffic splitting beyond canary
gaps.description: Flagger canary exists but no fine-grained traffic splitting (e.g., A/B testing, blue-green).
gaps.impact: Limited deployment strategy options
gaps.recommended_fix: Use Istio VirtualService for advanced traffic management

gaps.title: No distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger)
gaps.description: No OpenTelemetry Collector, Jaeger, or Tempo configuration. No trace collection or visualization.
gaps.impact: No visibility into request flows across services; difficult to debug latency issues
gaps.recommended_fix: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector as DaemonSet with Jaeger or Tempo backend

gaps.title: No application instrumentation
gaps.description: No OpenTelemetry SDK instrumentation in application code. No trace context propagation.
gaps.impact: Traces cannot be correlated across services
gaps.recommended_fix: Add OpenTelemetry Python SDK with auto-instrumentation for FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Kafka

gaps.title: No trace-based alerting
gaps.description: No alerting based on trace data (e.g., error rate by endpoint, latency percentile).
gaps.impact: No proactive detection of latency or error anomalies
gaps.recommended_fix: Configure alerting on trace-derived metrics (e.g., Prometheus alerts on span metrics)

improvements_since_v3: CI now has multi-arch Docker build (docker/build-push-action with platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64)
CI now has Trivy container image scanning
CI now has job dependencies (needs: [lint], needs: [test])
CI now has timeout-minutes on all jobs
Helm chart exists with deployment, service, and hpa templates
Helm template includes topologySpreadConstraints, securityContext, and HPA behavior policies
k8s/ has canary.yaml (Flagger), gpu.yaml, network-policy.yaml, pdb.yaml
summary.notes: Many v3 gaps persist because the raw k8s/ manifests were not updated to match the Helm template improvements. The Helm chart is the source of truth but is not integrated into CI/CD. Monitoring, backup, GitOps, multi-cluster, service mesh, and distributed tracing remain entirely absent.
